inputs.prompt: a close-up shot from a low camera angle looking upward. A young woman with a white bobcut with side-swept bangs, bright red eyes, white mouse ears with pink inner ears, pale skin and a slim athletic build stands arched over a crystal ball, both hands hovering around its base. She wears a floor-length purple wizard robe with a gold-edged shoulder cape embroidered with cheese wedges and stars, and a tall brimless cone hat of purple cloth covered in a gold cheese-wedge and shooting-star pattern, her mouse ears free at the sides; her robe sleeves and the hat ripple in a magical gust. The crystal ball rests on a purple table cloth in the bottom left foreground and glows blue; inside the crystalline orb floats a shining golden cheese wedge. She stares into the orb completely in awe, mouth agape with a slight greedy grin, eyes opened wide, the cheese wedge reflected in her pupils. An ornate dark oak chair stands behind her. An immense gothic library surrounds them, flanked by towering bookshelves. A small spiral of bluish glowing magical dust whirls around her and the orb, and loose pages of notes and a white goosefeather swirl through the air. The room is dark and leans red, lit mainly by the blue tint of the orb, while she is mainly purple. Ominous, magical and mysterious mood.
